inlines.v: ABHOR', verb transitive [L abhorreo, of ab and horreo, to set up bristles, shiver or shake; to look terrible.] 1. To hate extremely, or with contempt; to lothe, detest or abominate. 2. To despise or neglect. Psalms 22:24. Amos 6:8. 3. To cast off or reject. Ps. lxxix. 38.
